text:
ravi: Weekly release-train bulletin — please skim before EOD.

ravi: Cutover tomorrow 08:00 UTC. New items: temporary freeze extension policy and Priority Reservation for Dedicated customers.

ravi: Freeze extension: if a release owner flags a rollout as 'customer-impacting', embargo extends by up to 3h to allow targeted validation. Use the release metadata tag `freeze:extended` and add justification.

cecilia: Reservation details: infra-runbooks now include a `priority-reservation` label. To reserve, create an infra ticket with cluster id, duration, expected e2e qps, and attach the customer SLA. Infra will confirm and return a reservation token.

infra-bot: Infra policy update deployed: priority-reservation label accepted. See https://redwood.internal/infra/reservations for form.

taylor: Canary FYI 1: during the last small-scale rollout we saw a 12% increase in tail latency for sequences >1024 on `redwood-x1`. No error-rate change. We throttled rollout to 10% and kicked a metric-alert.

release-bot: Canary snapshot: redwood-x1 canary_2026-03-23-14:12  tail p99 +120ms, tail p95 +40ms. Rollout state: paused at 10%.

oncall-bot: Pager suppressed (inc 6892). Oncall: @taylor.

taylor: I'm digging into whether batching heuristics interacted with long-seq kernel paths. If we see a kernel mismatch, we will pin the v1 scheduling policy for canary nodes. ETA 90m.

cecilia: Heads-up to runtime teams: please avoid PRs that change batching windows or kernel-autoselect until the canary readout. If you need to push, request an exemption and include micro-bench artifacts.

ravi: For release owners: update the weekly changelog and include reservation tokens + canary observations. Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/weekly-changelog.

cecilia: Small procedural change: silent rollbacks (auto) will now create a follow-up ticket automatically. If you disagree with the rollback, comment on the ticket within 2h to request manual review.

release-bot: Auto-rollback policy updated: silent-rollbacks -> ticket creation enabled.

ravi: Thanks all. Post any critical observations here and well coordinate on next steps. :shipit:
